title: GLOBE: Evolving Structured Agentic Memory for E-commerce Product Optimization in Generative Search
abstract: arXiv:2610.23709v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Optimizing product listings for generative search requires language agents not only to rewrite effectively but also to continually self-improve by retaining successful strategies across diverse categories. However, existing approaches often treat structured listings as free-form text, leaving effective strategies implicit in prompts, search trajectories, or rewritten outputs rather than accumulating them as a reusable agentic memory. To address this limitation, we introduce GLOBE, an agentic framework that drives continual self-improvement by storing optimization knowledge in an evolving handbook of explicit, field-scoped behaviors. In each episode, an Editor applies relevant behaviors and receives rank-based feedback, which a Reflector converts into behavior updates. Crucially for dependable execution in real-world settings, a Moderator removes redundant proposals, a Curator commits accepted changes, and consistently harmful behaviors

translated_title: GLOBE：面向生成式搜索中电商产品优化的演化式结构化智能体记忆
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.23709v1 公告类型：cross 摘要：为生成式搜索优化产品列表，不仅要求语言智能体具备有效的改写能力，还需要它们通过在不同品类中保留成功策略来实现持续的自我改进。然而，现有方法往往将结构化产品列表视为自由形式的文本，导致有效策略隐含在提示词、搜索轨迹或改写输出中，而未能将其积累为可复用的智能体记忆。为解决这一局限，我们提出GLOBE，一个通过将优化知识存储在不断演化的、由显式的按字段划分行为构成的手册中，来驱动持续自我改进的智能体框架。在每一轮任务中，编辑器应用相关行为并接收基于排名的反馈，反思器将这些反馈转化为行为更新。对于在真实场景中可靠执行而言至关重要的是，调解器负责剔除冗余提案，策展人负责提交被接受的变更，而持续有害的行为……（原文在此处被截断）
tldr: GLOBE通过将电商产品优化知识不断积累并演化为结构化的按字段划分行为手册作为智能体记忆，使语言智能体能够在生成式搜索场景下实现持续的自我改进。
en_tdlr: GLOBE is an agentic framework that achieves continual self-improvement of language agents in generative search by evolving a structured handbook of field-scoped behaviors as reusable agentic memory for e-commerce product optimization.
